common_proposal_warning_analysis.catalog_provenance: states visited by the full-adapter arm on final seeds 8000-8127
common_proposal_warning_analysis.interpretation: All warning sources are scored on identical inputs from the full-adapter visited-state catalog. This is a controlled detector comparison conditional on that catalog, not a realized-outcome comparison or an independent sample.

attribution_diagnostics.contrast_status: JEPA-output-only versus full was one member of the prospectively specified family of risk-source contrasts, but it was not uniquely designated as the primary contrast.
attribution_diagnostics.on_policy_warning_population: Each original arm's warning metrics use the states and proposals visited by that arm; fixing the oracle logic does not fix the proposal population.
attribution_diagnostics.original_intervals: The original 95% intervals are pointwise and unadjusted.

claim_boundary: These analyses can qualify horizon-composition and warning-pipeline claims. They cannot establish architecture-only causality, detector superiority on an independently sampled population, physical safety, independent execution, or deployment readiness.

ferrumos.episode_rule: episode has at least one H=5 rollout endpoint

physical.episode_rule: episode has at least one H=5 rollout endpoint
